name: skill-recorder
description: Independent Windows demonstration recording and local evidence for Skill authoring. Includes its capture scripts; Nexts integration is optional.

interface.shortDescription: Demonstrate a task. Create a reusable Skill.
interface.longDescription: Record Windows demonstrations with the bundled native screen/input collector and local action processor. Requires Node.js and FFmpeg; no Claude Desktop or Electron installation is needed. Runs as an independent Skill, with optional Nexts chat consent, controls and evidence handoff.
defaultPrompt: /record-skill Record my workflow and turn it into a reusable Skill.
